sources.massAndROM: docs/combat-ai1-ledger.json and docs/training-ai1-v32.md: Winter/Dempster fractions and AAOS/Norkin & White ROM; unchanged

mass.weaponClassification: 원본 AK-74M physical.weightKg; 별도 낙하 강체
mass.mappingClassification: 기존 방호 메시 부착 뼈에 배분; 양쪽 어깨 보호구는 원본 쌍 장비 .85kg을 절반씩; 분절 배분은 공간 어댑터
mass.deduplication: Four vest soft meshes count as one vest; front/back neck meshes count as one collar; two shoulder meshes count as one pair; two distinct plates each count once
mass.omitted: Decorative pouches/knee covers have no equipped registry item in H01; no invented item mass. Ammo/inventory load beyond the specified armor kit is deferred

original.soldier: v33 54 bones, four native clips; finger GLB and common AK rotations unchanged
original.flightProtectionMedical: original source and generated declarations preserved byte for byte

medicalReadMapping.part: disabled, hp==0, functionRatio<=.12 →0; otherwise functionRatio in [0,1]
medicalReadMapping.spinal: existing spinalCordInjury A/B → leg strength0; arm output already contains original cervical cap
medicalReadMapping.jointStrength: generalStrength*affected limb function, torso retains generalStrength
medicalReadMapping.collapse: unconscious/dead/arrest or a leg function0; pain/MAP by themselves do not trigger collapse

controller.normal: position kinematic; existing movement capsule retained, query-invisible while physical and restored on recovery
controller.bodies: 17 massive segments plus1 collider-free kinematic pelvis target; gun3.6kg separate
controller.jointTargets: separate animation target skeleton; native crouch goal blended as consciousness/support is lost; local quaternion → captured joint frame
controller.spring: prebuilt generic six-axis pelvis joint, Rapier implicit force-based positional/angular motors
controller.recovery: RMS linear/angular speed, adequate general strength and small pelvis error; .35s dwell then .4s visual pose blend and kinematic recovery
controller.flinch: local target offset .075rad sine pulse .2s; actual impact momentum separately applied at completed body/armor contact
controller.ROMReference: measured neutral coordinate clamped to anatomical interval before frame capture; tuning, not a new human ROM source
controller.selfCollision: nonadjacent torso/leg capsules collide; intentional adjacent overlap and head/neck versus torso capsule overlap excluded; arms collide with legs/environment
controller.unconsciousFade: capture strength at loss of consciousness and fade that initial value over .22s; posture uses elapsed/fade progress, avoiding prior-weakness posture jumps

performance.prewarm: combat sector entry; prepared actor + rigid objects + dropped gun + isolated solver/medical/trace warmup + compile/offscreen first draw
performance.FX: 70 reusable impact marks, existing22 casing pool,16 pregenerated shot noise buffers; audio nodes still short-lived per shot

validation.mechanicalInputs: explicit medical output samples; not claims of clinical trajectories. Actual live trace/medical integration verified separately.
validation.bleedingOutputFixture: consciousness=max(5,65-30*t), MAP=max(25,70-25*t), unconscious when consciousness<20; this is a controlled adapter fixture, not a medical equation
validation.ROM: raw joint-frame angular diagnostic, strict numerical epsilon1e-5rad; separate2deg diagnostic is not the acceptance threshold
validation.torso: nonadjacent pelvis/spine/chest physical capsules only; adjacent joint-end overlap is intentional
validation.jitter: max component half-range over last1s; standing mode also checked before recovery
validation.slip: maximum horizontal ankle displacement within each continuous floor-contact episode
validation.trialAcceptance: all failures retained in acceptance.json and report; no assertion that this is production ready
